releaseNotes: PRVN Music v0.14.0 (Build 17): Complete Compose Multiplatform reimplementation based on official SimpMusic foundation; PRVN Dark (#0B0E14), Purple (#A855F7) and Cyan (#06B6D4) branding; full feature parity including Home, Browse, Mix for You, Charts, synchronized lyrics, 10-band equalizer, AutoEQ; robust Listen Together with MetroServer protocol and independent local stream resolution; Google Play Protect compliance.
